//: Every story flag used in dialogues.json, events.json and world.json, with how long it is remembered (GAME_DESIGN.md §12). scope: life = forgotten when the hydra dies; lineage = her heiresses keep it, a new lineage starts without it; world = world knowledge (secrets found, the Serpent heard, progress of mini quests), kept by every generation and every new lineage, because Old Mother Toad remembers. about: what the flag means, for whoever writes the next line. A flag missing here is an error at startup, so a typo in a flag's name is caught. TODO(design): the scopes are Claude's first choice.

heardSerpent.about: The Great Serpent has spoken to the heads.

toadTold.about: Old Mother Toad has explained the Serpent's voice.

heardMycelium.about: The mycelium of the Fungal Deeps has been heard.

metDiscordant.about: The Discordant (the drummer) have been met.

foundAncestor.about: The skull of an older hydra has been found.

hushedCarving.about: "The Silent Song", step 1: the Hushed carving was studied.

hushedMachine.about: "The Silent Song", step 2: the cold machine of the Hushed was found.

hushedMachineWoke.about: "The Silent Song", step 2: the machine woke up.

hushedSongHeard.about: "The Silent Song", step 3: the last note was heard (opens the Sealed Door).

hushedMaskTaken.about: "The Silent Song", step 3: the Hushed mask was taken (opens the Sealed Door).

hushedDoorOpened.about: A Sealed Door of the Hushed has been opened.

surveyChain.about: "The Subterranean Survey", step 1: the survey chain was followed.

surveyDone.about: "The Subterranean Survey", step 2: the surveyors were dealt with.

surveyStamped.about: "The Subterranean Survey", step 3: the hydra is officially surveyed.

ninefoldFriend.about: The Ninefold Camp counts this lineage as a friend.

angeredOneCoil.about: This lineage has angered the One Coil.

putOutFlame.about: A Flame Shrine of the Order has been put out on the surface (unlocks the Drought).
